channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula e Flávio brincam de “esconde-esconde” em debates
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado accused Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro of avoiding presidential debates, describing the situation as a 'hide-and-seek' where each conditions their appearance on the other's. He advocated for a confrontation based on concrete management data, criticizing Lula's alleged superficiality in speeches and questioning Flávio Bolsonaro's lack of administrative experience.

item.title: Vox Brasil: gestão Tarcísio é aprovada por 65,3% dos paulistas
item.description: The Vox Brasil Institute poll shows that 65.3% of São Paulo residents approve of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' administration, while 29.1% disapprove and 5.6% did not express an opinion. In the stimulated scenario, Tarcísio leads with 52.9% of voting intentions, followed by Fernando Haddad at 34.3%, suggesting a potential first-round victory.

item.title: Tarcísio marca 52,9% e venceria Haddad no 1º turno, aponta Vox Brasil
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll shows Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) would be re-elected in the first round with 52.9% of voting intentions, ahead of Fernando Haddad (PT) at 34.3%. In a simulated runoff, Tarcísio leads with 53.5% versus Haddad’s 35.8%, or 59.9% of valid votes. Haddad is the most rejected candidate at 47.5%, while Tarcísio has 24.3% rejection.

item.title: PT lança neste domingo, em SP, candidatura de Lula à reeleição
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) officially launched President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election bid for 2026 at its national convention in São Paulo on Sunday. Lula, aged 80, will seek a fourth presidential term, running again with incumbent Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) as his running mate. The coalition includes PSB, PCdoB, PV, PDT, PSOL and Rede, while main rival Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has yet to announce alliances.

item.title: Zema acusa Lula de "ilícito eleitoral" por pedir voto: "Um intocável"
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) accused President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva of committing electoral illicit by asking for votes before August 16, during a PT convention in Bahia. Zema criticized the Supreme Federal Court (STF), suggesting it was in coalition with the PT, and pointed out that Lula refers to Jaques Wagner as Senate government leader despite Wagner being under investigation by the Federal Police for allegedly receiving R$ 3.5 million and a luxury apartment from Banco Master’s owner. Zema also noted he himself is under investigation for a video using puppets to simulate dialogues between STF ministers.

item.title: Eduardo Leite anuncia fim do casamento com Thalis Bolzan
item.description: Rio Grande do Sul Governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) announced the end of his marriage to pediatrician Thalis Bolzan, following their stable union formalized in late 2023. In a statement, Leite said the decision was made maturely and by mutual agreement, preserving respect, affection, and admiration. The couple requested privacy and will not issue further comments.

item.title: Estarei na campanha de Flávio de um jeito ou de outro, diz Tereza
item.description: Senator Tereza Cristina, state president of PP-MS, said she will be part of Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign 'one way or another,' despite the party's neutrality. She had previously signaled willingness to be his running mate, and Governor Eduardo Riedel (PP-MS) advocated for her vice-presidential nomination at the União-Progressista Federation's state convention in Mato Grosso do Sul.

item.title: Frente de 9 partidos lança Riedel à reeleição em MS
item.description: The União-Progressista Federation formalized the re-election bid of Governor Eduardo Riedel (PP) in Mato Grosso do Sul, backed by a broad coalition of nine parties. Barbosinha (Republicanos) is the running mate for vice-governor, while Reinaldo Azambuja and Capitão Contar (both from PL) are competing for the two Senate seats. The alliance includes PP, União Brasil, PL, PSDB, Cidadania, MDB, Republicanos, Avante, and PSD.

item.title: Convenção do PL em SC com participação de Flávio usa vídeo com voz e imagens de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Santa Catarina state convention of the Liberal Party (PL) displayed a video featuring the voice and images of Jair Bolsonaro during an event attended by Flávio Bolsonaro, the party's presidential candidate. The video aimed to reinforce support for the former president and mobilize the party's electoral base.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro será candidata ao Senado pelo PL do Distrito Federal, diz Bia Kicis
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro will run for Senate representing the PL party in the Federal District, announced by Deputy Bia Kicis during the party convention in Brasília. Bia Kicis also confirmed her own pre-candidacy for re-election to the Federal Chamber, remaining on the same party ticket.

item.title: Richarlison garante vitória do Tottenham nos acréscimos sobre o Chelsea
item.description: Richarlison secured Tottenham's 2-1 victory over Chelsea in a pre-season friendly, scoring in the 47th minute of the second half after a rebound off the crossbar. Estêvão had opened the scoring for Chelsea, while Tonali netted Tottenham's other goal. Neither Brazilian scorer played in the 2026 World Cup due to injury (Estêvão) and tactical choice (Richarlison).

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro pedem votos durante convenções partidárias; saiba o que diz a lei
item.description: During party conventions held on June 1st, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro made explicit appeals for votes in their presidential candidacies, despite the legal ban on electoral campaigning before August 16. Experts note that such statements made at party conventions may be considered intraparty propaganda and therefore not necessarily illegal, as they are directed at party members during the internal candidate selection process. However, the dissemination of these moments on social media by the candidates’ own campaigns could constitute illegal early electoral propaganda.

item.title: PL usa áudio de discurso antigo de Bolsonaro durante convenção em SC
item.description: During the Liberal Party convention in Santa Catarina, a video featuring old audio from Jair Bolsonaro’s speech was played, including remarks on patriotism, the 2018 stabbing, and emotional messages. The video was shown before the final speech by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who was named by Jair Bolsonaro as his 2026 presidential candidate. Jair Bolsonaro is currently serving a 27-year-and-3-month sentence under house arrest for leading a coup plot.

item.title: As interferências externas que podem influenciar as eleições brasileiras
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections may be influenced by external interference, including diplomatic pressure, economic measures, disinformation campaigns, and scrutiny of the electronic voting system. Statements by Argentine President Javier Milei against Lula and the STF, along with potential U.S. verification missions to the electoral system, raise concerns about the internationalization of the race and effects on investor confidence and Brazil’s global image. The Trump administration, with tariffs on Brazilian goods and a renewed national emergency, maintains a posture of pressure on Brazil.

item.title: Com bolas na trave, Juventude e Atlético-MG empatam pela Copa do Brasil
item.description: Juventude and Atlético-MG drew 0-0 in the first leg of the Copa do Brasil, with both teams hitting the woodwork and creating chances. The second leg will be played at Alfredo Jaconi in Caxias do Sul on Tuesday (August 4) at 7:30 p.m. to determine who advances to the quarterfinals.

item.title: PL usa vídeo narrado por Bolsonaro em convenção; assista
item.description: The PL aired a video narrated by Jair Bolsonaro during a regional convention in Santa Catarina, emphasizing themes of family, faith, and patriotism, as his son Flávio Bolsonaro prepares to run for president in 2026. The video’s voice authenticity remains unconfirmed and was played before Flávio’s speech, raising concerns about potential AI use, similar to an AI-generated video shown at the party’s national convention in July. Bolsonaro, currently under house arrest following a conviction for attempting a coup, did not respond to Poder360’s request for comment.

item.title: Eduardo Leite confirma fim de união estável com médico capixaba
item.description: Rio Grande do Sul Governor Eduardo Leite confirmed the end of his stable union with physician Thalis Bolzan, following approximately one month of separation. The decision was made mutually and maturely, with mutual respect and affection, according to a statement sent to Metrópoles. Leite was the first Brazilian governor to publicly come out as homosexual in 2021.

item.title: Renan Santos confirma candidatura à Presidência com ataques a Lula e Bolsonaro
item.description: Businessman Renan Santos of the Missão party (linked to MBL) was officially nominated as a presidential candidate at a national convention in São Paulo's East Zone. In his speech, he criticized both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, rejecting political polarization and stating his party is not anti-PT but an independent political project. Despite having the smallest electoral fund (R$ 3.3 million) and no free TV/radio airtime, Santos ranks third in recent polls with up to 10% voter intention, relying on social media and electoral debates to gain visibility.

item.title: Em convenção do PL-SC, Flávio Bolsonaro pede voto. Lei proíbe
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) explicitly asked for votes during the PL-SC convention, violating electoral law that prohibits vote solicitation before August 16. He also accused Lula of being authoritarian and claimed Brazil is not under a full dictatorship. Hours later, his campaign announced it would file a complaint with electoral justice after Lula made a similar vote request at the PT convention in Bahia.

item.title: Com presença de Flávio Bolsonaro, PL-SC confirma Jorginho Mello candidato à reeleição no Estado
item.description: The PL of Santa Catarina confirmed Jorginho Mello as the gubernatorial re-election candidate at a state convention held this Saturday, the 1st, in São José. The event featured Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), presidential candidate, underscoring national party support for Mello’s re-election bid in the state.

item.title: Renan chama Moro de 'vassalo' e diz que vai tirar Flávio do segundo turno
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão Party presidential candidate, called Sergio Moro a 'vassal' and vowed to remove Flávio Bolsonaro from the 2026 election runoff. In a speech lasting over an hour, he also criticized Lula, governors who did not oppose bolsonarism, and claimed they all serve conservative interests.

item.title: Amor de Tarcísio faz do projeto de Bolsonaro coisa de amador
item.description: By declaring his love for Jair Messias Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas revealed that Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy is perceived as amateurish and weak. His statement, made during the convention launching his likely re-election as governor of São Paulo, highlighted the inability of Bolsonaro's son's presidential project to compete with the consolidated support for the father. Tarcísio's remark reinforced the notion that the Bolsonarist legacy is being sustained only through personal loyalty, not political strength or substantive policy.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro será candidata ao Senado em 2026, afirma Bia Kicis
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro will run for Senate in the Federal District in the 2026 elections, announced by federal deputy Bia Kicis during a PL party convention in Brasília. The move reflects the party's strategy to keep the Bolsonaro family prominent in national politics.

item.title: Assista ao discurso de Tarcísio na convenção do Republicanos em SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas had his re-election officially confirmed at the Republicans' state convention in São Paulo, where he thanked his family, God, and political allies including Flávio Bolsonaro and Jair Bolsonaro. He criticized Fernando Haddad and the Workers' Party, stating Haddad has 'clear rejection' in SP and 'promised everything and delivered nothing'. He praised São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes and emphasized women's security as a priority.

item.title: Moraes autoriza que Bolsonaro receba visita da cunhada durante exames de Michelle
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized Michelle Bolsonaro's sister, Geovanna Kathleen Ferreira Lima, to visit the family residence to care for the couple's 15-year-old daughter while Michelle undergoes medical exams for recurrent migraines. The ruling requires a prior inspection and mandates that cellphones be held by police officers during the visit.

item.title: Convenção do PL em SC tem pedido de voto de Flávio Bolsonaro; lei eleitoral prevê propaganda somente a partir de 16 de agosto
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro made explicit vote requests during the PL convention in Santa Catarina on August 1st, violating electoral law which prohibits campaign propaganda before August 16th. He also endorsed candidates including Jorginho Mello, Carlos Bolsonaro, and Carol De Toni. His speech was compared to Lula’s in Bahia, where the president made a more generic appeal for allied candidates before asking for his own vote.

item.title: MDB lança Hana Ghassan ao governo do Pará e Helder Barbalho ao Senado
item.description: The MDB officially nominated Hana Ghassan for governor of Pará and Helder Barbalho for the Federal Senate during a convention at Ginásio Mangueirinho in Belém. Ghassan, who assumed office after Barbalho's resignation to run for Senate, had 24% voting intentions in the May Quaest poll, tied with Daniel Santos (Podemos). Barbalho, a two-term governor (2019-2026), leads Senate race polls, as the MDB aims to maintain its political influence in the state and nationally.

item.title: União Brasil fica fora da disputa ao Senado em PE após ser rifado por Lyra e Campos
item.description: União Brasil ended up without a Senate candidate in Pernambuco after former Petrolina mayor Miguel Coelho was overlooked by both Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) and former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB). Lyra withdrew her own candidacy to back Eduardo da Fonte (PP), president of the União-PP federation, to secure the federation’s support and more TV time for her re-election bid. Campos instead supported Marília Arraes (PDT), cousin of the former mayor, leaving Coelho out despite his pre-campaign efforts with both camps.

item.title: Lula chega à sétima disputa ao Planalto com versão 3.0 do ‘nós contra eles’
item.description: Lula will launch his seventh presidential campaign with the 'us against them' slogan in its 3.0 version, emphasizing national sovereignty and stoking fear of a Bolsonaro family return to power. The PT's strategy aims to win over independent voters and reduce abstention, despite Lula's 46% rejection rate and Flávio Bolsonaro's 48%. The campaign kicks off at the PT convention with Geraldo Alckmin as running mate, amid external tensions such as U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods.

item.title: Sem merecer novo mandato, Lula é favorito com discurso velho e erros do rival
item.description: Although most Brazilians believe Lula does not deserve a new term, he remains the frontrunner in polls due to opposition missteps, particularly by Flávio Bolsonaro, whose campaign has been hampered by financial controversies, ties to Donald Trump, and family disputes. Lula capitalized on these errors by adopting a tougher rhetoric against his rival and launching populist measures, even as public debt costs rose and unpopular policies like the 'blusinhas' tax were reversed. Corruption resurfaced via the Master case involving Jaques Wagner, a close ally of Lula, further complicating his re-election bid.

item.title: Bia Kicis diz que Michelle Bolsonaro será candidata ao Senado: 'Acabou a dúvida'
item.description: Bia Kicis declared that Michelle Bolsonaro will be a Senate candidate for the Federal District, stating that 'the doubt is over'. Michelle had previously said she was still discussing the candidacy with Jair Bolsonaro and that her priority was caring for him, as he is under house arrest. The PL convention in the DF, scheduled for this Sunday (2), is expected to formalize the candidacies.

item.title: Missão lança candidaturas e 'desafia' Lula e Flávio para debate com Renan
item.description: The Missão movement officially launched Renan Santos as its presidential candidate and other candidates for state governorships, in a convention marked by boos for Lula (PT) and criticism of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with a focus on combating organized crime.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chama Lula de 'projeto de ditador' e diz que vai 'demiti-lo' em outubro -
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, called President Lula a 'dictatorship project' during a party convention in Santa Catarina and said he will 'fire him' in the October elections. The remarks were made at the event that formalized Jorginho Mello's reelection bid as governor.

item.title: Renan Santos ataca Lula e Flávio, chama Moro de 'vassalo' e promete 'matar quem roubar'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Mission party, harshly criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro during his campaign launch, calling Sergio Moro a 'vassal' and threatening to 'kill whoever steals'. He rejected ideological labels attributed to him but maintained a hardline stance against corruption and violence.

item.title: Com ingressos open bar, Missão promove candidatura de Renan Santos à Presidência
item.description: The Missão party, founded by MBL creators, held its first national congress in São Paulo to promote Renan Santos’ 2026 presidential candidacy. The event, held in a nightclub-style venue with open bar, VIP sections, and jaguar-themed symbolism, drew a predominantly male crowd aged 30–40, featuring speeches by Kim Katagiri and Aroldo Medina, who referenced Jânio Quadros and emphasized male authority. Santos was praised by allies for his role in Dilma Rousseff’s 2016 impeachment, despite the party’s receipt of over R$3 million from the FEFC fund, which was not disclosed during the event.

item.title: Estreante em eleições, Renan Santos é empresário e fundador do MBL
item.description: Renan Santos, businessman and founder of the Free Brazil Movement (MBL), launched his presidential candidacy under the Missão party, created in 2025. He centers his campaign on public safety, advocating for harsher penalties, mass prison construction, abolishing presumption of innocence for gang members, and drawing inspiration from Nayib Bukele. His platform includes labor reform, a crypto reserve, drastic spending cuts, and tying mayors' re-election to performance targets.

item.title: PL lança candidatura de Bia Kicis ao Senado pelo DF
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) launched the candidacy of federal deputy Bia Kicis for the Senate in the Federal District, following two terms in the Chamber of Deputies. Kicis stated she seeks the Senate to oversee other branches of government, including the power to question Supreme Court ministers. She also confirmed that former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro will be the PL's second nominee in the race for DF's two Senate seats.

item.title: Flávio repete Lula e também pede voto antes do prazo permitido
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential candidate, publicly asked for votes at a PL party convention in Santa Catarina on August 1st, before the August 16th legal campaign start date set by the TSE. He mirrored the same action taken earlier that day by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at a PT event in Bahia. Neither campaign responded to Poder360’s request for comment by the time of publication.

item.title: Assista ao discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro na convenção do PL em SC
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and PL presidential candidate, spoke at the party's convention in Santa Catarina, calling President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a "dictatorship project" and vowing to defeat him in the October elections. He urged voters, even those who dislike him, to support him to prevent the continuation of what he described as "this gang's government." The full 25-minute and 23-second speech was made available for viewing.

item.title: “Não vou dar gás nem celular para ninguém”
item.description: The Mission Party launched the presidential candidacy of Renan Santos in São Paulo, proposing policies on employment, security, and poverty reduction while criticizing welfare programs and stating he does not intend to expand the distribution of benefits such as gas and cell phones.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro compara situação do pai ao período de repressão durante o AI-5, na ditadura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro compared his father Jair Bolsonaro's legal situation — convicted of attempting a coup — to the repression period under AI-5 during Brazil's military dictatorship. The statement was made on April 1st during his presidential campaign, sparking controversy for equating a judicial conviction for undermining democracy with historical authoritarian measures.

item.title: Após questionamento de Moraes, Flávio usa novo vídeo com Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL convention in Santa Catarina aired a new video featuring Jair Bolsonaro's speeches, despite prior questioning by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes regarding the use of his image. The event, attended by Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential pre-candidate, also included criticisms of the Judiciary.

item.title: Sérgio Moro é xingado e vaiado em congresso do Partido Missão
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro (PL-PR), a candidate for governor of Paraná, was heckled and booed during the National Congress of the Partido Missão in São Paulo, where Renan Santos formally launched his 2026 presidential bid. Santos accused Moro of betraying the legacy of Operation Car Wash (Lava Jato) by submitting to forces that, he claimed, destroyed the operation, and criticized Moro’s tenure as Justice Minister under Bolsonaro. Moro had joined the PL in March after disagreements within the União-PP federation, seeking to realign with the Bolsonaro clan.

item.title: Flávio está sendo preparado para perder para o Lula, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, the presidential candidate of the Partido Missão, launched his campaign in São Paulo and claimed that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is being prepared to lose the election to President Lula (PT). He rejected the label and criticized his opponent during the party's first National Congress.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula e Flávio brincam de 'esconde-esconde' e preferem discutir sobre Trump que educação no Brasil
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for avoiding presidential debates, accusing them of 'playing hide-and-seek' and prioritizing international polemics — such as commenting on Donald Trump's dentures — over national issues like education. He claimed his candidacy is more competitive due to his clean record, emphasizing 40 years in public office without involvement in scandals like mensalão, petrolão, or illicit enrichment.

item.title: Convenção do PSD lança Arruda candidato ao GDF sem vice definido
item.description: The PSD launched José Roberto Arruda as its candidate for Governor of the Federal District, despite his conviction for administrative improbity and ineligibility in six cases, currently under review at the STF. Arruda claims he will use the loosening of the Clean Record Law to defend his candidacy registration until August 15. The event featured support from Ronaldo Caiado, Gilberto Kassab, Alberto Fraga, and Izalci Lucas, but no vice-governor has been confirmed yet.

item.title: A palestra de Dias Toffoli na República Dominicana
item.description: Minister of the TSE and STF, Dias Toffoli, participated in a seminar in the Dominican Republic on artificial intelligence and electoral management in Latin America and the Caribbean. He spoke on a panel about the exchange between electoral bodies regarding advances and challenges of AI in the region. The event included representatives from international organizations and countries outside the region.

item.title: Lula e Flávio são “grandes adversários da população”, diz Caiado
item.description: Former Governor of Goiás Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are 'great adversaries of the Brazilian population'. The remark was made in Florianópolis during the PSD state convention that formalized the candidacy of former Chapecó mayor João Rodrigues for governor of Santa Catarina. Caiado positioned himself in opposition to both the federal government and the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Em convenção, PCB confirma Edmilson Costa como candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) officially nominated Edmilson Costa as its presidential candidate for the 2026 elections, with Cleusa Santos as his running mate. Both hold doctorates and have backgrounds in academic political activism. Costa advocated for the nationalization of the financial system, suspension of public debt payments, and increased state control over exchange rates, foreign trade, and enterprises.

item.title: Prendemos Lula e o STF soltou, dizem Deltan e Moro
item.description: Deltan Dallagnol and Sergio Moro released a photo together wearing shirts claiming they imprisoned Lula and that the STF released him, tying the Lava Jato operation to their 2026 election campaign. Dallagnol, a Senate candidate for Novo-PR, and Moro, a gubernatorial candidate for PL in Paraná, emphasize their Lava Jato legacy despite past judicial and electoral controversies.
